summary: Adversarially re-verify the D409 harness repair regions (R1~R19) across 3 lenses

results.lens: SCIENCE-MATH — R1 ordered chord-bound certification traversal (worker cyld29h50_d409_zero_step_dual_jaw_contact_region_enumeration_worker.py)

warnings.claim: Certification uses strict comparison of raw hppfcl GJK distances against the chord bound with no numerical-error allowance; a certification passing with margin below the GJK tolerance (1e-9 m = 1e-6 mm, ~1.5% of the terminal-width bound 6.73e-5 mm) is theoretically unsound.
warnings.evidence: worker line 1345 'max(hi_e["min_mm"], lo_e["min_mm"]) > bound_mm' with DistanceRequest tolerance 1e-9 (line 754). Observed real-pose margins are orders of magnitude larger (e.g. 2.83 mm vs 3.24 mm bound at anchor width; dense scan worst floor margin +1.19 mm), so this is a disclosed-precision caveat, not an observed defect.

warnings.claim: On the anchor_granularity_uncertified fallback, pinch predicates, the barrel/cap feature, and moving_witness_top_margin_mm are computed at the coarse anchor-level q5* and published into non-gated CSV columns (pinch_core_pass, rim_proximal_lt_7p5mm) and the admission-layer rim_proximity_cell_fraction diagnostic without a per-column coarse-provenance marker.
warnings.evidence: worker lines 1552-1559 (fallback crossing) feed lines 1582-1655 (feature/pinch) whenever endpoint_contract_valid; scenario-D probe confirmed all gated quantities (crossing_exists_in_open_interval, first_crossing_order_certified, b_pass, full_pass) are false, so no gated leak — consumers must join on the adjacent first_crossing_order_certified CSV column to filter the diagnostics.

confirmations: (a) max() criterion CONFIRMED sound: gripper joint axis is exactly (0,0,1) in the child frame (URDF link5_to_gripper_link), vertices are child-frame local, radial norm is convex so vertex max bounds all mesh points; empirical max vertex displacement between adjacent anchors 3.2435930094497755e-3 m vs bound 3.243593009449777e-3 m (attained, never exceeded); per-point 1-Lipschitz argument survives min-over-64-parts and either-endpoint form; 39-sample dense interval scan on a real pose: 0 violations of the implied floor (worst margin +1.19 mm); EPA/overlap values are never used in clear-clear certification.

(b) Sub-resolution acceptance CONFIRMED fail-closed: synthetic competitor part at min distance 1e-5 mm (below terminal bound 6.73e-5 mm) 1.5e-6 rad above the crossing -> interval rejected (max_d 4.523e-5 <= bound 4.950e-5), order_certified=false, gated b_checks false; competitor at qc+2e-4 rad (outside CERT_NEIGHBORHOOD_RAD 6.4e-5) -> adjacency rejected, fail-closed; real pose (0,6500) exercised the acceptance path (1 accepted, per-part exclusion pass, disclosed q5_star_resolution_rad 7.35e-7).

(c) Traversal order CONFIRMED: synthetic transient overlap strictly between anchors k=7/k=8 (no anchor inside dip; old bisection would publish a false later crossing at ~0.30 rad) was found as the FIRST crossing: q5*=1.1984617190501012 vs true upper zero 1.1984615384615385 (inside the 7.35e-7 bracket), correct part, certified with 16 new evals; left-first recursion with stop-on-True guarantees q5-descending order; continue-on-sub-resolution intervals are all adjudicated post-traversal (accept or reject), never silently skipped.

(d) Fallback CONFIRMED fail-closed: sub-bound slope (1 mm/rad vs coefficient 134.7 mm/rad) exhausted the 48-eval cap -> refinement=anchor_granularity_uncertified, width 0.0482 rad, width_le_contract=false, crossing_exists_in_open_interval=false, first_crossing_order_certified=false, b_pass=false, full_pass=false, queries 5248 <= 5400; coarse q5* cannot reach any passing gated quantity.

(e) Budget arithmetic CONFIRMED: anchor gate measured exactly 128 queries; worst-case pose 64+33*64+48*64=5248 <= 5400; worst-case run 128+1239*5248=6,502,400 <= 7,000,000 (raise points cannot fire spuriously); 8 real poses (4 domain corners, mid-grid (7250,9000), positive control (7000,11000), (250,6750), (14250,11250)): queries 3456-3840, identity queries_used == 2176+64*new_evals held 8/8, all 8 order_certified with 0 unresolved and 0 rejected intervals.

(f) Determinism CONFIRMED: canonical-JSON result bytes SHA256 bit-identical across two separate isaaclab-python processes with different PYTHONHASHSEED for poses (0,6500)/(7250,9000)/(14500,11500); memo keys are deterministic float values from a fixed dyadic recursion over float32 anchor endpoints.

(g) Regression invariant CONFIRMED: independently reimplemented as-authored final-pair bisection (dyadic descent, hi-clear/lo-overlap, q5*=hi) matched the certified traversal bit-exactly (float equality of q5_star_rad and identical first_contact_part) on all 8 real probe poses.
notes: b_check width_le_contract reflects the bracket width (<=1e-6 rad) only; with accepted sub-resolution intervals the effective first-crossing resolution can be up to bracket width + 6.4e-5 rad, disclosed separately in order_certification.q5_star_resolution_rad — this matches the declared R1 semantics (chord displacement at the cap ~4.3e-3 mm, far below the 0.1 mm CLEAR_GATE).

first_contact_part is the argmin part at the bracket clear endpoint; a competitor within bound(bracket width) ~1.35e-4 mm of the minimum could in principle touch first inside the bracket (no per-part exclusion is run on the bracket interval itself). This ambiguity is pre-existing as-authored bisection semantics, not introduced by R1; the ungated consistency flag first_contact_part_consistent_with_overlap_deepest and the competitor_exclusion check at the overlap endpoint partially mitigate; inner-vs-inner misattribution is immaterial to the inner17 gate.

Probe-side science observation (not an R1 defect): cylinder_witness_barrel_interior_strict was false at all 8 probed poses (witness on cap/rim region), so b_pass and full_pass were false throughout the probe sample; certification itself was healthy at all 8. Full-grid outcome not evaluated (single-pose in-memory probes only).

One synthetic scenario (B4, near-touch plateau min 2e-5 mm without actual contact) initially looked like a missed sub-resolution case but is CORRECT max()-criterion behavior: the upper endpoint distance exceeded the width bound, soundly certifying the interval; the certificate excludes contact, not small clearance.

All probes were in-memory module-function calls under /home/cgxr/miniconda3/envs/isaaclab/bin/python -B; no repo files or runtime_logs folders were created or modified.
